name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A free, 523-lesson curriculum that teaches you to build real AI systems (agents, LLM apps, MCP servers) from the ground up, in several languages.
buyer: A bootcamp, corporate learning-and-development team, or career coach who wants a ready-made curriculum to teach AI engineering skills without building the content from scratch.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp licenses or white-labels the curriculum structure to launch a paid 'AI Engineer' track.
A corporate L&D team assigns specific learning paths (e.g. Agent Engineering) to upskill existing developers internally.
An independent educator builds a paid cohort-based course or mentorship program using the free curriculum as the syllabus, charging for live guidance and code review.

money_ideas.idea: Paid cohort-based course with live mentorship layered on top of the free, open curriculum.
Corporate training package sold to engineering orgs, billed per seat.

steal_this: Package one learning path (e.g. Agent Engineering) into a $200 paid cohort with weekly office hours this weekend, using the free lessons as your syllabus.
